subject: Post-call recap — HorizonPay evidence playbook & next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Dunn <arielle.d@horizonpay.com>, Marcus Lowe <marcus.lowe@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed evidence path from today's call

Hi Arielle / Marcus — thanks again for the time today. Thought Id capture what we discussed and the recommended next steps so we have a clear evidence path for your security and procurement teams.

Key pain points you raised
- Audit log retention: need 7 years for payments flows and 1 year for other events; concern around secure archival and access controls.
- SOC 2: HorizonPay requires visibility into scope (infra vs. infra+app), and a gap list for items that are not currently covered by your internal control set.
- Pen test: regulatory team wants summary findings + mitigation timelines (not the raw report).
- DPA / legal redlines: you'd like a Matt-level redline review and a data residency clause for US-only processing.

What Redwood can commit to (proposed)
- Provide an evidence matrix mapping SOC 2 controls → artifacts we can deliver (logs, config screenshots, runbooks). Attachment: redwood-evidence-matrix.csv
- Exportable audit log samples and retention config docs; propose a configurable retention policy with legal review for the 7-year exception.
- Share a high-level pen-test summary (we can redact sensitive vuln details) and our remediation timeline.
- Start a DPA redline thread with our contracts lead; we can circulate a tracked-change DPA within 3 business days.

Proposed owners & dates
- Neha (Infosec) — assemble SOC 2 artifact list and sample artifacts by 2027-08-06.
- Marissa (Customer Success / Onboarding) — coordinate DPA redline & procurement touchpoints, target 2027-08-05 for initial tracked DPA.
- Sean (Sales/Engops) — schedule a technical deep-dive with your platform engineering to map log sources and retention feasibility (target 2027-08-03).

Immediate asks for you
1) Please confirm the 7-year retention scope (payments flows only vs. platform-wide).
2) Share preferred contact for legal (for DPA) and the procurement SLA reviewer.
3) If you have a preferred format for the pen-test summary or redaction requirements, flag them now.

Attachments: horizonpay-soc2-questions.xlsx (short Q list), redwood-evidence-matrix.csv (initial mapping)

If that aligns, Ill kick off the internal threads and set up the technical deep-dive.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Arielle Dunn <arielle.d@horizonpay.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lowe <marcus.lowe@horizonpay.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed evidence path from today's call

Sean — really useful summary, thanks. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: 7 years applies to payment transaction logs and any disbursement-related audit trails. Application-level debug logs can be 1 year.
2) SOC 2: our auditor will want to see evidence of log integrity (WORM or equivalent), access reviews (last 6 months), and change-control for infra. If you can map those controls in your matrix that will help speed the review.
3) Pen test: we need a single-page findings summary we can share with our CISO; redactions are fine but include CVSS buckets and whether the issue is fixed / in-progress.

Contacts: Legal = Marcus Lowe (cc'd); Procurement SLA = me (Arielle).

Wed like the DPA redline within 3 business days if possible. Also — can you confirm if Redwood supports customer-managed KMS or HSM for key custody? Our security team will flag that as high priority.

I attached the pen-test summary we ran internally last quarter that shows the format we like: HorizonPay-pen-test-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Arielle Dunn
Director, Security & Compliance | HorizonPay
arielle.d@horizonpay.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-02T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + proposed evidence path from today's call

Forwarding Arielle's confirmations — please see inline notes and proposed owners. I'm asking Neha to lead SOC 2 artifacts and Marissa to own the DPA/procurement lane.

- Marissa: open DPA redline with Legal; prioritize data residency clause (US-only) and standard indemnities. Target: 2027-08-05 for initial tracked DPA. HubSpot deal HP-2314 linked below.

Thanks — Ill own the SOC 2 evidence packet. Initial plan and timeline below: 

Deliverables and owners
- 2027-08-04: Audit log export samples (anonymized) + export schema (Neha)
- 2027-08-05: Access review screenshots and service account inventory (Neha)
- 2027-08-06: Change-control runbook excerpt + mapping to SOC 2 control IDs (Neha)

Open tech questions for Eng (Sean to coordinate)
- Can we enable WORM-style retention for the transaction logs and produce attestable proof?
- Do we support CMK (customer-managed keys) for workload encryption in production, and what KMS vendors are compatible?

I'll start a shared Drive folder and drop the initial CSV mapping there. Marissa — once you have the DPA redline, ping me and Ill add the artifact references into the packet. Arielle — if your auditor needs a SOC 2 scope statement, I can draft a short summary for review.

-Neha Kapoor
